taskTemplates.title: Identify viable agricultural products in {country}
taskTemplates.deliverable: Table of quantity, harvested area, yield, trend and data flags; verify domestic food needs and producer constraints before proposing export growth
acceptance: Every numeric claim has source, year, unit, retrieval date and flag
Candidate products are hypotheses until local surplus and supply feasibility are evidenced

taskTemplates.title: Compare destination demand for {product} from {country}
taskTemplates.deliverable: Ranked destination matrix with imports, trends, competitors, unit values and coverage
acceptance: Record HS revision and commodity concordance
Distinguish direct, mirror and re-export data
Unit values are trade averages rather than a supplier quotation
Export potential estimates are modeled opportunities rather than confirmed demand

taskTemplates.title: Verify entry requirements for {product}: {country} to {destination}
taskTemplates.deliverable: Applicable tariff/origin/SPS/TBT checklist with regulator and expiry/review dates
acceptance: Confirm current national customs and agricultural regulator primary sources
Notifications alone do not establish the complete current law
Official enquiry points are regulatory contacts rather than buyers

taskTemplates.title: Identify validated buyers and an export route for {product}
taskTemplates.deliverable: Buyer shortlist and logistics feasibility with verified corporate procurement contacts
acceptance: Verify buyer identity, remit and public contact route
Distinguish potential buyers from contracted offtake
Use dated freight quotations and evidence of cold-chain/storage requirements
No messages are sent from a research task

taskTemplates.title: Draft agricultural trade recommendation for {country}
taskTemplates.deliverable: Recipient-specific municipality/ministry brief with product opportunity, evidence, bottlenecks, implementation steps, budget assumptions and measurable pilot
acceptance: Verify recipient authority on the official national or municipal website
Human review required before external publication or sending
Identify missing evidence and expected impact as scenarios rather than established results

proposedTaskRecord.status: queued | claimed | researching | evidence_ready | in_review | approved | blocked | rejected
proposedTaskRecord.scaleRule: Generate country/template research queue first. Add product and destination combinations only after evidence identifies relevant candidates, to avoid an arbitrary combinatorial backlog. A queued task is not completed research.
